_comment: Single source of truth for per-subdomain branding (docs/subdomain-branding.md). Edit THIS file, then run `python scripts/sync_brands.py` — it regenerates the BRANDS block in web/branding.js (client-side fallback) and functions/_lib/brands.js (Pages Function middleware). tests/test_brands_sync.py fails on drift. SEO copy must fit the repo's own gates: seoTitle 30-70 chars, metaDescription 50-160 chars (scripts/seo_check.py enforces them on the served page). The 2026-11-26 trims vs branding.js v1: app seoTitle shortened (was 79 chars), all five metaDescriptions trimmed to <=160 chars (were 163-207) — meaning kept, words cut, see docs/ssr-branding.md.
